body: claude-storymodel4s: the six storymodel4s beads now carry WHY/SCOPE/ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA/PROPOSED TESTS, plus a new p0 prerequisite bd-01M14JYVJ7ZY0ASHJ3ZR4K850A (topology-neutral labelled-neighbourhood protocol; graph4s becomes one adapter). Dependency order: protocol -> {directed WL, portable emitter, edge policy, overlay hardening}; laws in parallel; 0.1.0-M1 publication last. Guardrails baked into every bead: undirected-parity law against the GraKeL/GraphKernels.jl fixtures (bit-identical), portability law (standard gains no JVM-only import; CI on JS/Native), protocol minimality (the trait exposes only what refinement consumes). grakern stays a kernel calculus: reification and key choices live in the consumer (storymodel4s embed-grakern), never here.
